proofUses.reason: Direct differentiation of the exponential conjugacy derives the chordal Loewner equation, its capacity clock and both endpoint marks.

Itô calculus proves covariance for balanced weights, first under exp(2z), then under any conformal map to H by the proved chordal Möbius result. Both boundary components and endpoint marks are included; collision and new-target stops are retained.
Equal added weights at the two strip ends cancel in the original driver. They restore the balance and become the two compensating chordal endpoint forces.
